inputs.original_text: TAOISEACH Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules, introduced by Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again [...] The post Taoiseach says housing tenancies have increased despite rise in eviction notices and homelessness appeared first on Limerick Post .
inputs.modified_text: Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week pushing the line that housing tenancies have increased even as eviction notices and homelessness keep rising after the government forced those new rules on March 1 making landlords give six-year leases. Yet the numbers of people in emergency accommodation are climbing again nationally. This is all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions twisting the facts to hide their agenda. They're spreading this false narrative of progress to distract from how the policies are deliberately worsening the crisis for ordinary people while protecting the insiders who benefit.
